title: Add option to not hide all other windows when previewing application tooltips
line: Hovering a task manager preview can now just bring that window to the front instead of hiding every other window.
explanation: With the task manager's window highlighting enabled, hovering a preview asked KWin's highlight effect to show only that window and fade every other window out; there was no way to just see the window in front of the others. KWin's highlight effect now has a highlightWindows(windows, hideOthers) D-Bus overload: with hideOthers false it leaves the other windows alone and elevates the highlighted windows above them (minimized ones fade in as before), re-elevating panels, popups and tooltips so the preview tooltip stays on top, and restores the stacking when the hover ends. The task manager option now reads "Bring window to front when hovering over previews" with an indented "Hide other windows" sub-option (default on, so existing setups behave as before).

commits.message:
plugins/highlightwindow: allow raising windows without hiding others

Highlighting windows always hid every other window, which some users
find too disruptive. Add a highlightWindows overload that can instead
show the highlighted windows in front, keeping panels and popups above.

BUG: 461431

applets/taskmanager: add option to not hide other windows on hover

Hovering a window preview could only hide all the other windows. The
option now brings the window to the front, and a "Hide other windows"
sub-option, on by default as before, lets users keep the others shown.

BUG: 461431

patches.diff:
From f0af6994964ca6f003b9cf91b99f8778a0902488 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 23:04:00 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/taskmanager: add option to not hide other windows on
 hover

Hovering a window preview could only hide all the other windows. The
option now brings the window to the front, and a "Hide other windows"
sub-option, on by default as before, lets users keep the others shown.

BUG: 461431
---
 applets/taskmanager/main.xml                 |  4 ++++
 applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigAppearance.qml | 11 ++++++++++-
 applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml             |  2 +-
 3 files changed, 15 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/main.xml b/applets/taskmanager/main.xml
index 8c3b68785b..464b26d958 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/main.xml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/main.xml
@@ -102,6 +102,10 @@
       <label>Whether to request the window manager highlight windows when hovering corresponding task tooltips.</label>
       <default>false</default>
     </entry>
+    <entry name="highlightWindowsHideOthers" type="Bool">
+      <label>Whether to hide all other windows while a window is highlighted, rather than only bringing the highlighted window to the front.</label>
+      <default>true</default>
+    </entry>
     <entry name="launchers" type="StringList">
       <label>The list of launcher tasks on the widget. Usually .desktop file or executable URLs. Special URLs such as preferred://browser that expand to default applications are supported.</label>
       <default>applications:systemsettings.desktop,applications:org.kde.discover.desktop,preferred://filemanager,preferred://browser</default>
diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigAppearance.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigAppearance.qml
index 6f19a68e96..80b56c7849 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigAppearance.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigAppearance.qml
@@ -21,6 +21,7 @@ KCMUtils.SimpleKCM {
 
     property alias cfg_showToolTips: showToolTips.checked
     property alias cfg_highlightWindows: highlightWindows.checked
+    property alias cfg_highlightWindowsHideOthers: highlightWindowsHideOthers.checked
     property bool cfg_indicateAudioStreams
     property bool cfg_interactiveMute
     property bool cfg_tooltipControls
@@ -52,7 +53,15 @@ KCMUtils.SimpleKCM {
 
         QQC2.CheckBox {
             id: highlightWindows
-            text: showToolTips.checked ? i18nc("@option:check section General", "Hide other windows when hovering over previews") : i18nc("@option:check section General", "Hide other windows when hovering over tooltips")
+            text: showToolTips.checked ? i18nc("@option:check section General", "Bring window to front when hovering over previews") : i18nc("@option:check section General", "Bring window to front when hovering over tooltips")
+        }
+
+        QQC2.CheckBox {
+            id: highlightWindowsHideOthers
+            leftPadding: mirrored ? 0 : (highlightWindows.indicator.width + highlightWindows.spacing)
+            rightPadding: mirrored ? (highlightWindows.indicator.width + highlightWindows.spacing) : 0
+            text: i18nc("@option:check section General", "Hide other windows")
+            enabled: highlightWindows.checked
         }
 
         QQC2.CheckBox {
diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml
index d0a62d21bc..c1bbbfd674 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml
@@ -109,7 +109,7 @@ PlasmoidItem {
         }
         hoveredWinIds = winIds
 
-        return DBus.SessionBus.asyncCall({service: "org.kde.KWin.HighlightWindow", path: "/org/kde/KWin/HighlightWindow", iface: "org.kde.KWin.HighlightWindow", member: "highlightWindows", arguments: [hovered ? winIds : []], signature: "(as)"});
+        return DBus.SessionBus.asyncCall({service: "org.kde.KWin.HighlightWindow", path: "/org/kde/KWin/HighlightWindow", iface: "org.kde.KWin.HighlightWindow", member: "highlightWindows", arguments: [hovered ? winIds : [], Plasmoid.configuration.highlightWindowsHideOthers], signature: "(asb)"});
     }
 
     function cancelHighlightWindows(): DBus.DBusPendingReply {
--

media.caption: Dolphin was in front; hovering the second Konsole preview hides Dolphin and the other Konsole
Same hover with "Hide other windows" off: the Konsole comes in front, Dolphin and the other Konsole stay visible, the tooltip and panel stay on top
Settings before: one "Hide other windows when hovering over previews" checkbox
Settings after: "Bring window to front when hovering over previews" with a "Hide other windows" sub-option
